I am a 43-year-old woman farming in Dowa, Malawi. This small rented plot is only 0.13 hectares and intercropped, so I will use seed I saved from my own harvest rather than buying expensive improved seed. I cannot afford chemical fertilizer or pesticide for this plot, and we have no irrigation, so we depend entirely on rainfall. My family will work this plot ourselves over the season since it is small enough that we do not need to hire extra hands.
